semantic_change_summary: VannaBase.generate_sql accepts caller-prefetched entity candidates and bounded EAV value profiles while preserving legacy retrieval fallback.
EAV profiles are rendered as deterministic database facts and exact-value SQL guidance; incomplete profiles do not authorize invented values or fuzzy predicates.
Entity prompt construction supports per-type top-k limits and JSON-encoded aliases with deterministic normalization.
The OpenAI adapter accepts an explicit base_url and disables ambient proxy inheritance for loopback development endpoints.

upstream_boundary.compatibility_evidence: black-box entity API test plus recorded upstream comparison in docs/knowledge-platform/vanna-baseline.yaml
